answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like a trellis that only holds weight when each vine is tied to its own post. A new identity must post a violet-flagged bond, work under a sable audit trail of verifiable tasks, and forfeit the bond if peers catch it cloning work. One honest agent pays once; a sybil farm pays per identity, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds while earning nothing until each one proves real work.
